title: Goodwill Reporting Pitch
chrome: Chorizo Power · Goodwill Michiana · synthetic data

slides.title: Goodwill builds three reports *by hand*.

quotes.label: Monthly
quotes.text: From manual reporting to management visibility. A monthly E-Commerce dashboard should balance growth, profitability, productivity, inventory management and customer engagement.

quotes.label: Nightly
quotes.text: A nightly report creates a daily pulse. Each nightly report should show both revenue and customer count by marketplace, followed by enterprise totals.

quotes.label: Month-end
quotes.text: From manual month-end close to Business Central integration. The current close combines portal downloads, emailed reports, bank activity, spreadsheet rules and manual Business Central entries.

slides.attribution: Debie Coble, President and CEO, Goodwill Industries of Michiana
slides.notes: Goodwill's words, from Debie Coble's deck. Three reports, all by hand today. Their goal: automate the rules, not just the downloads.

slides.title: One program builds *all three*.
slides.notes: Left: the files Goodwill already gets. Middle: our program cleans, checks and calculates, every night and again at month-end. Right: the nightly pulse, the monthly scorecard, and the files Business Central imports.

slides.label: Demo
slides.title: Here it is, *running*.
slides.notes: Switch to terminal and browser. Pulse, scorecard, close. One continuous recording.

slides.title: It *checks its own work*.
points: Matches totals to a separate answer key
Writes a journal only if it balances
slides.notes: Expected totals are computed from the generated orders, apart from the program. The journal is refused unless it balances. A missing report shows as missing, not as zero.

slides.title: A missing report gets *named*, not hidden.

steps.head: It gets an owner
steps.text: Listed, kept out of the journal

slides.notes: Every payout is checked against the files for its own days, so errors can't cancel out in a total. If a report is missing, the close names it and gives it an owner. Drop the report in, run again, and it clears.

slides.title: What is real, and what we *simulated*.
slides.notes: Read it plainly. Nothing real from Goodwill has gone through it yet. The Business Central files are import files; nothing is posted.

slides.label: The ask
slides.title: Send us one real month of files.
slides.notes: One real month and last month's allocation workbook. Then we compare our journal with theirs, line by line.
